description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the Provider class in the OpenMRS core API. It tests methods related to retrieving a provider's name and string representation, focusing on Provider object behavior with associated Person and PersonName objects.

classes.name: ProviderTest
classes.description: JUnit test class validating behavior of the Provider class, particularly methods getName() and toString().

methods.name: getName_shouldReturnPersonFullNameIfPersonIsNotNullOrNullOtherwise
methods.description: Tests that Provider#getName() returns the full name of the associated Person when present, otherwise null.

methods.name: toString_shouldReturnPersonAllNamesWithSpecificFormat
methods.description: Tests that Provider#toString() returns a formatted string including provider ID and full name.
